description: Upload an image as an attendee's answer to an image custom field (see list_custom_fields) on an open Registration Sheet or Booking Agent, before signing them up or changing their answer. Send the image file's bytes as base64: a PNG, JPEG or WebP, 5 MB or smaller. This tool never downloads an image from a link. Returns answer, a reference to pass as that field's answer in register_attendee, book_appointment, update_registration_answers or update_booking_answers. Uploading signs no one up and emails no one.

custom_field_id.description: The image field's customFieldId from list_custom_fields.

image_base64.description: The image file's bytes, base64-encoded. A data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine.

name: upload_custom_field_image
title: Upload an image answer
